_comment: Brew Match difficulty modifiers (v1.2 plan section 5). Applied in code on top of each level; level files are never edited. moves/stars are factors (1.3 = +30 %; movesAtStart = factor for the gentlest levels, blending into moves for the hardest; levelMoves = per-level factor); collect = factor for 'collect N ingredients' goals (0.85 = 15 % fewer). Normal was made easier than the levels as designed on 2026-10-25 (owner: +10 % moves, fewer items). hintDelay in seconds, null = idle hint off (hint button only); obstacleRelief = layers taken off 2-layer foam/crates; wortSpreadEvery = Sticky Wort spreads every Nth quiet move; spawnBias = chance (0..1) a new tile copies a neighbour's colour. Vouchers and QR rewards are the same on every difficulty. Tune with: dart run tool/simulate.dart
